audit.whatIsWrong: The chart gave Graves Levels 1 and 2 at 3.5/10 and marked Levels 3, 6 and First item as Skill — on a page whose own why-text says 'Level 1 favours you', 'Level 2 stays yours', 'Level 3 you dominate', 'Level 6 favours you', 'First item is yours'.
audit.why: 52.55% over 9243 games — the largest sample in this slice — and the packet chart reads Garen for all six early stages with Graves only at 2+ items. The chart disagreed with the win rate, the packet and its own prose.
audit.corrected: Chart flipped as one group: Garen from Level 1 through First item, Graves at 2+ items, ratings raised to 6/10, and the two chart summary lines rewritten.

audit.whatIsWrong: Smoke Screen was described three times as a blind. It is not a blind — Riot's text is a smoke cloud that reduces sight range, plus impact magic damage and a brief slow.
audit.why: A blind would make Garen's autos miss; a sight-range cut does not touch his damage at all, it only removes his vision of Graves. Telling a Garen player his damage is blinded changes what he does with a trade he is actually still winning. Quickdraw was also listed at a flat 13s; it is 16/15/14/13/12 and its cooldown is reduced by landing basic attacks.
audit.corrected: Smoke Screen restated as a vision cut with its 26s rank-1 cooldown; Quickdraw's real 16s and its attack-driven cooldown reduction written in.

audit.whatIsWrong: No spike was tied to a real number, and the packet flagged 'NO cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere'.
audit.why: The sequencing that matters is Quickdraw's 16s at rank 1 versus Decisive Strike's flat 8s — Garen gets two Q windows per Quickdraw, and Graves' shell reload is the second timer.
audit.corrected: Both timers written into report[5], dosFull[0] and the commit line.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing said End of the Line detonates on terrain, and nothing warned that Garen has no dash out of it.
audit.why: Graves' Q explodes on colliding with terrain, so hugging a wall turns his poke into a guaranteed full-damage hit and can cut a retreat Garen cannot dash out of.
audit.corrected: Terrain detonation added to Common Mistakes.
